'''''Koh-Lanta: Le Totem maudit''''' ({{translation|"Koh-Lanta: The Cursed Totem"}}) is the twenty-third regular season of the [[France|French]] reality television series ''[[Koh-Lanta]]''. 24 contestants are split into three tribes and sent to live and survive in the [[Calamian Islands]] of the [[Philippines]] where they compete against each other for immunity and reward while also avoiding tribal council.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.parismatch.com/Culture/Medias/Koh-Lanta-le-totem-maudit-decouvrez-le-visage-des-24-aventuriers-de-la-saison-1785341#|title="Koh-Lanta, le totem maudit" : découvrez le visage des 24 aventuriers de la saison|first=Léa|last=Bitton|date=2 February 2022|access-date=2022-02-02|website=Paris Match}}</ref> The main twist this season is The Cursed Totem which is given to the tribe or contestant that finishes last in a challenge where they'll receive a 'curse' that they must endure for their loss.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.huffingtonpost.fr/entry/koh-lanta-le-totem-maudit-va-venir-pimenter-la-nouvelle-saison-sur-tf1_fr_61fcf21fe4b0b69cfe8d3aea|title="Koh-Lanta": le totem maudit va venir pimenter la nouvelle saison sur TF1|first=Benjamin|last=Ferrari|date=4 February 2022|access-date=2022-02-08|website=HuffPost}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.20minutes.fr/arts-stars/television/koh_lanta/3229595-20220204-koh-lanta-conditions-tournage-nouveautes-surprises-totem-maudit-reserve|title=" Koh-Lanta " : Conditions de tournage, nouveautés… Quelles surprises " le totem maudit " réserve-t-il ?|first=Clément|last=Rodriguez|date=4 February 2022|access-date=2022-02-08|website=20 Minutes}}</ref> The season premiered on 22 February 2022 on [[TF1]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.europe1.fr/medias-tele/koh-lanta-quest-ce-que-le-totem-maudit-la-grande-nouveaute-de-la-prochaine-saison-4091388|title="Koh-Lanta" : qu'est-ce que le totem maudit, la grande nouveauté de la prochaine saison ?|first=Héloise|last=Goy|date=2 February 2022|access-date=2022-02-08|website=Europe 1}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.lavoixdunord.fr/1136365/article/2022-02-04/koh-lanta-totem-maudit-equipes-candidats-ce-qu-sait-sur-la-nouvelle-saison|title="Koh-Lanta" : Totem maudit, équipes, candidats... ce qu’on sait sur la nouvelle saison|first=Camille|last=Bronchart|date=4 February 2022|access-date=2022-02-08|website=La Voix du Nord}}</ref>
